spans.s: mf(ई). = तेर्˚, L.
fr. तीर-भुक्ति.
‘melody of the Ṛṣi Tiraścī’, N. of a Sāman, TāṇḍyaBr. xii; Lāṭy. vi, 8, 12.
‘extending beyond (तिर॑स्) a pause (विर्˚)’, the dependant Svarita in a compound when the Udātta upon which it depends stands on the last syllable of the 1st member of the compound, VPrāt. i, 118
(called प्रातिहत, TPrāt.)
‘extending beyond the consonant (व्य्˚)’, the dependant Svarita when separated by one or more consonants from the Udātta syllable upon which it depends, RPrāt. iii, 10; APrāt. iii, 62; VPrāt. i, 117.
= तिर्˚, ĀśvŚr. v, 5.
mf(ई)n. relating to a Tīrtha g. शुण्डिकादि and व्युष्टादि.
तैर्˚थक mfn. g. धूमादि.
तैर्˚थिक mfn. (g. छेदादि) = तीर्थ्˚, addicted or relating to another creed, heterodox, Kāraṇḍ. xi, 62
तैर्˚थिक m. a dignified person, authority, Prab. ii, 13/14
तैर्˚थिक n. water from a Tīrtha, MBh. iii, 8085
= तीर्थचर्या (?), xiii, 6066.
तैर्˚थ्य g. संकाशादि.
measured by the revolution (तिर्यग्-अयन) of the sun (a year), Lāṭy. iv, 8, 7; Nidānas. v, 12.
= तिर्˚, of animal origin, (m.) animal, Mn. vii, 150; Suśr. vi, 39
See ˚न्य.
तैर्यग्यो˚नि mfn. id., MBh. v, 97, 6
relating to the animals (creation), Sāṃkhyak. 54, Gauḍap.
तैर्यग्यो˚न्य mfn. id., 53 (v.l. ˚न), VP. i, 5, 21; MārkP. vlii, 33.
